turnout.notes: South Dakota turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows until a state-native turnout artifact is collected.

historicalBaselines.warning: South Dakota historical baseline rows are county-level presidential results from 2012, 2016, and 2020 Wikipedia county tables with source footnotes. Use them as contextual baseline rows, not as 2024 certified data.

reviewCharts.warning: South Dakota review rows are county-level President-versus-at-large-U.S.-House comparisons. The generated CSV values are exactly validated against the retained official State Board of Canvassers certificate, but retain secondary extraction lineage; ElectionID 684 XLSX is labeled unofficial and lower-total. These rows are not precinct-level vote-share scatter plots.
